lines.en: Even if your attention is split between several places and several times right now, it’s important to remember how  everything is connected — but I’m not talking about butterflies.

Because it isn’t what comes after the caterpillar that matters in the long run, it’s the ones who chronicle their actions and stages of development. Who give them names or press their bodies into rectangular frames.
And while all living things carry some level of importance, specifically that which can be held by wings, we often overestimate just what those wings are capable of.
If such a small amount of flapping can tear a city to shreds, I wonder why those wings never flapped until something compelled them to.
You can talk about what affects what all day long. You can sit on your throne with a roll of red tape, then cover your eyes so all you’ll see is that you’ve always been right.
You can make any puzzle piece fit if you cut it or mold it into what’s meant to be there. You can do anything you set your mind to.
But the truth is this-
Both triumph and failure are scripted. Because if you can do anything, anyone can do anything. Anything can do anything. And this creates a world of limitless possibilities.
It creates an infinite amount of worlds where different things are happening. Some wild by comparison, some tame. But again, it’s never the butterfly that serves as the bringer of destruction.

It’s the library of outcomes. That hall of impossible possibilities, where each door opens to a new world with new familiarities, accompanied by little more than happenstance and minute changes that, you guessed it-
Lack the power to ever destroy anything at all.
If something breaks here, somewhere else it won’t.
So if you just so happen to find yourself in a place where things don’t go the way you like, that’s okay.
Because there’s somewhere out there where they will.
You just need to figure out how to get there.
You know...
Maybe God is just the thought of God.
It’s powerful enough.
It drives us to do insane things — it drives us to this. And so much has happened that I can barely tell what this is anymore.
All I know is that there is beauty to be found in everything.
You just need to look closer.
: You really went overboard this time, Ami. I seriously can’t believe you just carved a hole into Nodoka’s abdomen with the same knife we were using to cut up the roast Ayane’s butler made.
: I’m sorry, Mom. I promise it won’t happen again.
: Ugghhhh fine. I’ll let you off with a warning this time. But at least let your father penetrate the next girl before you start stabbing her to death.
: Hahahahahahaha!
: Sorry for the mess, Dad. I told myself I’d be a good girl for your sake tonight, but I guess I really fudged that up, huh?
: What made you snap anyway, Ami? Was it just the fact that Nodoka hugged your daddy out of nowhere that sent you over the edge?
: Soooooomething like that~
: Well, whatever the case, don’t let it happen again! Cause I’m sure you know what needs to happen now to clean up after your mess, right?
: Awwww man! But I was really looking forward to Christmas this year!
: Well, you’ll just have to look forward to it next year instead. Because SANTA is always watching, Ami. And SANTA knows when you’ve been naughty or nice.
: Hey, you don’t think Daddy’s going to be like that for the rest of the night, do you? I was hoping the three of us could go trick-or-treating again this year.
: I’m not sure, Ami. He did just see something pretty horrific. But I’m also assuming it’s not the first time he’s seen a dead body if what he was telling me earlier was actually true.
: I don’t really get it. But if I made you sad, Daddy, I’m sorry.
: Oh! I’ve got an idea, though! Maybe I could give you a blowjob to help!

: Ooooh! Tempting, isn’t it Aki-kun? Blowjobs don’t count as sex, you know. Surely you can still “love” your daughter by your own definition if you let her suck on your penis for a little while, right?
: Oh, but maybe you want to get dressed first. I don’t want Ami getting her hoodie all messy. It’s the only change of clothes I packed.
: It’s fine, Mom. We should probably get going soon anyway. The cops could be here any minute.
: Are you okay to drive, Aki-kun? Because I know you hate it when I do, but you seem pretty out of it right now. And I don’t want to make you do anything you’re uncomfortable with.
: Ah! Sometimes, forcing people to do things they're not comfortable with is the best way to move them forward.
: Ooooh! Where’d you hear that one, lightning bug?
: Mmmm...I forget!
: Well, I guess it doesn’t really matter. A phrase is a phrase is a phrase. If you’ve heard one, you’ve heard them all.
: Now, how about we go stop for ice cream? We should have time for that before the grand finale, right?
: Grand...finale?...
: Oh, good! Daddy’s rejoined us. I was beginning to think we’d need to get the jar out again.
: Both of you...
: Are fucking insane...
: I mean, yeah. Was that not obvious when I coerced a teenage girl into riding you like a bucking bronco an hour or two ago?
: We’re not “insane,” Daddy. We just really, really love you! Which is exactly why we keep trying to create safe spaces for you.
: But it’s okay! Because even if I accidentally ruined this one, I’m sure there’s another one waiting for you just around the bend.
: Now, put that in your pipe and smoke it.
: AAAGGGGGHHH!!! I can’t believe that just happened! What the fuck, Ami?!
: Heehee! You came so many times I’m surprised you’re still awake!
: And I just...went along with it...even after you took off the shackles...

: Yeah, cause you’re a slutty lil’ slut who cums after like five seconds. But don’t feel bad, Maya. I’ve got like, kadrillions of years worth of experience and you’re just a cute little baby bird right now!
: I got so many good pictures too. This’ll make capturing Sensei’s heart like fifty times easier.
: This is all a part of the plan...and if I was tied to a chair and sexually abused for several hours, it’s because I had to be in order to be reunited with Akira...
: It’s not abuse if you like iiiiit~
: Yes it is, you fucking psychopath! How did you even get me here?!
: I already told you. You blacked out and I carried you here.
: Yes, that’s what you said! But of course I’m not going to believe that when you’re only an inch or two taller than me and probably just as strong!

: Well, I don’t know what you want me to say. It’s not like I’m just going to reveal all of my secrets to you just because you’re probably going to be deleted in a few minutes. Some secrets need to stay secrets.
: What do you mean “deleted?”
: The world’s starting over again, so it’s time for Maya to go bye-bye. This one’s not meant to be here.
: How...How do you know that, though? Are you in control of this stuff?
: God, I wish. I don’t control anything. I’m just good at stuff. But you’re an idiot, so you’re probably going to die now. Oh well.
: And there’s...nothing you can do to make me stay?
: Weren’t you just bitching like three seconds ago about how I “sexually abused” you? And now you want to stay with-
: Oh. Yeah, on second thought, that makes sense.
: I don’t...count what happened between Sensei and me as abuse...
: Yeah, because you’re a lovestruck little bimbo who’s devoted her life to chasing after the only dick she’s ever felt inside of her.
: So are you, Ami...
: We’re the same and you know it.
: Noooo. I’ve lived through unspeakable trauma. How about you? Where do you come from, Maya?
: What do you mean where do I come from? I-
: Wait...
: I...I don’t...
: There’s no use in trying to remember.
: You haven’t known for as long as we’ve been friends. And we’ve been friends for a reaaaaaally long time.
: But...how can I not...
: Because you were never meant to be here at all. You’re an accident. Unwanted. And I’ve got all I’ve wanted out of you, so either shut up and die quietly or...
: Actually, that’s it. Just shut up and die quietly. Kaythanksbye.
: What’s going to happen next?...
: Are you going to do it?...
: I might have to if you don’t shut your fucking mouth, jeez.
: But no.
: The sky will take care of that for me.
: When the fuck did the moon get so much more...moony?
: You’ve never noticed that before? It just kind of happens sometimes.

: Then, in a few minutes once the reset starts, the sky will get all multicolored and pretty. It’s actually really nice if you can separate yourself from the crippling fear of not knowing what comes next.
: I don’t know...I might be having second thoughts about this. Will shit start lookin’ normal again if I head back to the hotel now?
: Probably not. I think you’re basically screwed now. So you either come with me and we face this together, or you head home to find that everyone you know has essentially vanished.
: The fuck you mean “vanished?”
: I wish I knew. The only real experience I have with it is when Maya disappeared once, but...something about Sensei being nearby sort of pulled her back into existence.
: Maybe it was a coincidence. Maybe he can do that with everyone if he knows where they are. But it’s not like we can find out here when this Sensei isn’t ours.
: Well...how’s he different? Cause I ain’t seen him and I...ain’t really gettin’ it.
: Apparently he just has sex with Ami and watches football.
: Football? Really?
: It’s weird when that’s the surprising part, right?
: Well, yeah. Dude would fuck anything that moves. And it ain’t like she doesn’t want it.
: Do you really think Sensei’s that bad, Yumi?
: I...I do, yeah. But I also...I...I don’t know. It’s fuckin’...complicated.
: I feel like he goes out of his way to be worse than he actually is and...I think I...I can kind of relate to that? But I don’t want to. I just-
: Should we even be doin’ this right now? Ain’t we got a world to like...reset or whatever?
: You’re right. We can continue this conversation on the roof if there isn’t anything horrible or curious waiting for us there.
: The fuck would be waitin’ for us there?
: This, I guess.
: The fuck?...
: Hello and welcome to congratulations! The ceiling has become the floor!
: And we have become cats! Nyaa!
: That too! Nyaa!
: Aight. Well, I fucking hate this.
: Would you believe me if I told you this was one of the less weird things I’ve seen up here?
: You’ve seen nothing yet, no no no! Right now, this is the waiting room!
: Where girls and boys of different groups can play before they meet their DOOM!
: But we only have girls.
: Oh, yes. Only girls it is. How very comedy of us!
: Yumi, you’re not going to like this, but I think we need to hug now.
: What? Ew. Fuck off.
: No, like that’s just a part of the process. We need to be touching for it to work, I think.
: Just because you think doesn’t mean you think right!
: Like when you try to wear black when you’re meant to wear white!
: The dawning of a new day is upon us! The two of you have passed the test!
: You’ve survived a new world! You are simply the best!
: Would this be a good time to compliment your breasts?
: No.
: We have never been good at girl. Not even when we are girl.
: This body is spry and full of juice! The kind you can grow trees with!
: You are thinking of acorns, delightful plebeian! Correct your anecdotal wordspew!
: Here are wordspews we can all understand! Praise be!
: Praise be!
: Praise be.
: Bruh.
: When in Rome, Yumi. When in Rome.
: She jokes the jokes she has to joke because she doesn’t know!
: That heat alone is not enough to melt the fallen snow!
: It would take a million tries for you to make a light that glows!
: But only one or two to give your Father what is owed!

: They’re not talking about your dad, Yumi. I think they’re talking about some kind of god.
: She’s right, she’s right! A thousand rights! A million rights, it’s true!

: ...Yeah.

: Well, what are we supposed to do if you two are so smart?! Maya clearly isn’t coming and I can’t figure this out on my own! No matter how hard I try, nothing ever works! It doesn’t make-

: I don’t know...But whatever it is, it’s not good.
: Oh, great fuckin’ observation! Really thought someone might be comin’ to rescue us for a second!
: Right you are but wrong you are! Rescued you will be!
: But not the way you HOPE for. Don’t blink or you won’t see!
: HOLY SHIT! WHAT THE FUCK IS THIS THING?!

: SILENCE, LESSER ONES!!! OR I WILL CRUSH YOUR BONES ONCE MORE!!!

: Pain is real! Pain is bad! Spare us, Father! We’ll be good!

: kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk
